## Cuiwei Gao

I am an independent researcher and R package developer working at the
intersection of biostatistics, public health, and clinical informatics.

### Research Focus

- **Genomic surveillance methodology** — statistical models for tracking
  pathogen lineage dynamics and informing public health response
- **Algorithmic fairness in clinical AI** — post-hoc auditing tools to
  detect and mitigate disparities in clinical prediction models
- **Privacy-preserving data generation** — synthetic data methods that
  enable multi-site clinical research under HIPAA/GDPR constraints

### CRAN Packages

I maintain four R packages on CRAN:

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [lineagefreq](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lineagefreq) | Lineage frequency dynamics and growth advantage estimation |
| [survinger](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survinger) | Design-adjusted inference for pathogen lineage surveillance |
| [clinicalfair](https://cran.r-project.org/package=clinicalfair) | Algorithmic fairness assessment for clinical prediction models |
| [syntheticdata](https://cran.r-project.org/package=syntheticdata) | Synthetic clinical data generation and privacy-preserving validation |

### Portfolio

End-to-end analyses showcasing applied R for biostatistics and
public health decision-making:

[**cuiweig.github.io/portfolio**](https://cuiweig.github.io/portfolio)

Four independent case studies covering variant forecasting,
algorithmic fairness audit, surveillance design optimisation,
and synthetic data release — each built entirely with my CRAN
packages on real or realistically-simulated data.
